name: Caraway Seeds
siboNotes: Caraway seeds are naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated in typical culinary amounts. Their carminative properties may actually help reduce digestive discomfort.
preparationTips: Lightly toast whole seeds before grinding to enhance flavor
Use sparingly as the flavor is quite potent
Store in airtight container to maintain potency
Can be used whole or ground depending on recipe needs
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants and essential oils
Traditional digestive aid with carminative properties
